_howToEdit: Stop the api container before editing this file so a running write does not replace your changes.
Dates use YYYY-MM-DD and times use 24-hour HH:MM.
IDs may be omitted on new users, supplier products, materials, shipments, items, and availability windows; DockFlow assigns them at startup.
Supplier accounts need role supplier, a supplierId, and an email. One active supplier account must link directly to one suppliers[] record.
Normal delivery proposals should be added by importing an SDS spreadsheet in Schedule. Identical proposals remain unchanged and changed pending proposals are updated.
Imported proposals start at PENDING_SUPPLIER. The supplier confirms one truck and its material codes at a time until every code has a truck.
A manually added user may use a plain password field once; DockFlow replaces it with passwordHash on startup. Never place Gmail or SMTP passwords in this JSON file.
